mapper.select: SELECT e.id AS excerpt_id,e.attachment_id,l.excerpt_id AS baseline_excerpt_id,l.attachment_id AS baseline_attachment_id, l.status,l.ai_use,l.revision,l.created_at,l.updated_at,e.created_at AS excerpt_created_at FROM material_excerpt e JOIN material_attachment a ON a.owner_id=e.owner_id AND a.id=e.attachment_id AND a.sha256=e.attachment_sha256 AND a.status='READY' LEFT JOIN material_excerpt_lifecycle l ON l.owner_id=e.owner_id AND l.excerpt_id=e.id WHERE e.owner_id=#{owner} AND e.id=#{id}

SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM preparation_material_reference WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND excerpt_id=#{id}) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ai_material_draft_source WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND excerpt_id=#{id}) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ai_material_qa_source WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND excerpt_id=#{id}) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ai_fact_draft_material WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND excerpt_id=#{id}) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ai_relation_evidence_material WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND excerpt_id=#{id}) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ai_source_qa_source WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND excerpt_id=#{id}) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM knowledge_relation_evidence_material WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND excerpt_id=#{id}) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM standard_review_evidence WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND excerpt_id=#{id})

SELECT
EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM preparation_material_reference r WHERE r.owner_id=#{owner} AND r.excerpt_id=#{id} AND ( EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM preparation_item child WHERE child.owner_id=r.owner_id AND child.project_id=r.item_id) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM preparation_reference ref WHERE ref.owner_id=r.owner_id AND ref.preparation_source_item_id=r.item_id) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ai_preparation_source source WHERE source.owner_id=r.owner_id AND source.source_item_id=r.item_id AND ( EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ai_candidate_decision d WHERE d.owner_id=source.owner_id AND d.task_id=source.task_id AND d.status<>'IGNORED') OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ai_question_decision d WHERE d.owner_id=source.owner_id AND d.task_id=source.task_id AND d.status<>'IGNORED') OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ai_expression_decision d WHERE d.owner_id=source.owner_id AND d.task_id=source.task_id AND d.status<>'IGNORED') OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ai_preparation_plan_decision d WHERE d.owner_id=source.owner_id AND d.task_id=source.task_id AND d.status<>'IGNORED') OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ai_jd_requirement_decision d WHERE d.owner_id=source.owner_id AND d.task_id=source.task_id AND d.status<>'IGNORED')))))
EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM preparation_material_reference WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND excerpt_id=#{id}) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM knowledge_relation_evidence_material WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND excerpt_id=#{id}) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM standard_review_evidence WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND excerpt_id=#{id})
OR EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM ( SELECT s.owner_id,s.task_id, CASE WHEN t.id IS NOT NULL AND t.purpose IN ('KNOWLEDGE_DRAFT','QUESTION_DRAFT') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS supported, CASE WHEN t.id IS NOT NULL AND t.purpose='KNOWLEDGE_DRAFT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS knowledge_adoption_supported FROM ai_material_draft_source s LEFT JOIN ai_task t ON t.owner_id=s.owner_id AND t.id=s.task_id WHERE s.owner_id=#{owner} AND s.excerpt_id=#{id} UNION ALL SELECT s.owner_id,s.task_id, CASE WHEN t.id IS NOT NULL AND t.purpose='MATERIAL_QA' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS supported, 0 AS knowledge_adoption_supported FROM ai_material_qa_source s LEFT JOIN ai_task t ON t.owner_id=s.owner_id AND t.id=s.task_id WHERE s.owner_id=#{owner} AND s.excerpt_id=#{id} UNION ALL SELECT s.owner_id,s.task_id, CASE WHEN t.id IS NOT NULL AND t.purpose='FACT_DRAFT' AND s.kind='MATERIAL' AND p.task_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS supported, 0 AS knowledge_adoption_supported FROM ai_fact_draft_material s LEFT JOIN ai_task t ON t.owner_id=s.owner_id AND t.id=s.task_id LEFT JOIN ai_fact_draft_source p ON p.owner_id=s.owner_id AND p.task_id=s.task_id AND p.kind=s.kind WHERE s.owner_id=#{owner} AND s.excerpt_id=#{id} UNION ALL SELECT s.owner_id,s.task_id, CASE WHEN t.id IS NOT NULL AND t.purpose='RELATION_DRAFT' AND s.kind='MATERIAL' AND p.task_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS supported, 0 AS knowledge_adoption_supported FROM ai_relation_evidence_material s LEFT JOIN ai_task t ON t.owner_id=s.owner_id AND t.id=s.task_id LEFT JOIN ai_relation_evidence_source p ON p.owner_id=s.owner_id AND p.task_id=s.task_id AND p.kind=s.kind WHERE s.owner_id=#{owner} AND s.excerpt_id=#{id} UNION ALL SELECT s.owner_id,s.task_id, CASE WHEN t.id IS NOT NULL AND t.purpose='SOURCE_QA' AND s.domain='MATERIAL_EXCERPT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS supported, 0 AS knowledge_adoption_supported FROM ai_source_qa_source s LEFT JOIN ai_task t ON t.owner_id=s.owner_id AND t.id=s.task_id WHERE s.owner_id=#{owner} AND s.excerpt_id=#{id} ) registered
WHERE registered.supported=0 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ai_candidate_decision d WHERE d.owner_id=registered.owner_id AND d.task_id=registered.task_id AND (d.status IS NULL OR (d.status<>'IGNORED'
AND (d.status<>'ADOPTED' OR registered.knowledge_adoption_supported=0)
))) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ai_question_decision d WHERE d.owner_id=registered.owner_id AND d.task_id=registered.task_id AND (d.status IS NULL OR d.status<>'IGNORED')) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ai_fact_draft_decision d WHERE d.owner_id=registered.owner_id AND d.task_id=registered.task_id AND (d.status IS NULL OR d.status<>'IGNORED')) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ai_relation_decision d WHERE d.owner_id=registered.owner_id AND d.task_id=registered.task_id AND (d.status IS NULL OR d.status<>'IGNORED')) )

SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ai_question_source WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND source_item_id=#{itemId}) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM question_knowledge_reference WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND knowledge_item_id=#{itemId}) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ai_card_draft_source WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND source_item_id=#{itemId}) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM memory_card_source WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND knowledge_item_id=#{itemId}) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM memory_card_concept WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND concept_id=#{itemId}) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ai_relation_source WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND source_item_id=#{itemId}) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM knowledge_relation_supplement_source WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND source_item_id=#{itemId}) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM preparation_reference WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND knowledge_source_item_id=#{itemId}) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM knowledge_board_reference WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND item_id=#{itemId}) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM training_question_knowledge_snapshot WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND knowledge_item_id=#{itemId}) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM training_draft_knowledge_reference WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND knowledge_item_id=#{itemId}) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM training_answer_knowledge_reference WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND knowledge_item_id=#{itemId}) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM standard_review_evidence WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND knowledge_item_id=#{itemId}) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM interview_event_material WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND knowledge_source_item_id=#{itemId}) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM memory_attempt_knowledge_source WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND knowledge_item_id=#{itemId}) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM memory_source_history_knowledge_reference WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND knowledge_item_id=#{itemId}) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ai_source_qa_source WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND knowledge_item_id=#{itemId})
OR EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM ai_draft_knowledge_input s WHERE s.owner_id=#{owner} AND s.knowledge_item_id=#{itemId} AND ( NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ai_task t WHERE t.owner_id=s.owner_id AND t.id=s.task_id AND t.purpose='KNOWLEDGE_DRAFT') OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ai_candidate_decision d WHERE d.owner_id=s.owner_id AND d.task_id=s.task_id AND (d.status IS NULL OR d.status NOT IN ('IGNORED','ADOPTED') OR (d.status='ADOPTED' AND NOT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM ai_knowledge_source k WHERE k.owner_id=s.owner_id AND k.task_id=s.task_id AND k.source_item_id=s.knowledge_item_id AND k.source_version_id=s.knowledge_version_id)))) ) ) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM today_placement WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND source_kind='KNOWLEDGE_DRAFT' AND source_id=#{itemId})
OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM today_placement_history WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(snapshot_json,'$.snapshot.source.kind'))='KNOWLEDGE_DRAFT' AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(snapshot_json,'$.snapshot.source.id'))=#{itemId})

knowledge_item_id=#{itemId}) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM memory_card_concept WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND concept_id=#{itemId}) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ai_relation_source WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND t.purpose='KNOWLEDGE_DRAFT') OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ai_candidate_decision d WHERE d.owner_id=s.owner_id AND d.task_id=s.task_id AND (d.status IS NULL OR d.status NOT IN ('IGNORED','ADOPTED') OR (d.status='ADOPTED' AND NOT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM ai_knowledge_source k WHERE k.owner_id=s.owner_id AND k.task_id=s.task_id AND k.source_item_id=s.knowledge_item_id AND k.source_version_id=s.knowledge_version_id)))) ) ) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM today_placement WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND source_kind='KNOWLEDGE_DRAFT' AND source_id=#{itemId}) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM today_placement_history WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(snapshot_json,'$.snapshot.source.kind'))='KNOWLEDGE_DRAFT' AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(snapshot_json,'$.snapshot.source.id'))=#{itemId})

SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM material_excerpt e LEFT JOIN material_excerpt_lifecycle l ON l.owner_id=e.owner_id AND l.excerpt_id=e.id WHERE e.owner_id=#{owner} AND e.attachment_id=#{attachmentId} AND (l.excerpt_id IS NULL OR l.attachment_id<>e.attachment_id OR l.created_at<>e.created_at OR l.status NOT IN ('ACTIVE','ARCHIVED') OR l.ai_use NOT IN ('ALLOWED','REVOKED') OR l.revision<0 OR l.revision>9007199254740991 OR l.updated_at<l.created_at OR (l.revision=0 AND (l.status<>'ACTIVE' OR l.ai_use<>'ALLOWED' OR l.updated_at<>l.created_at))))
mapper.update: UPDATE material_excerpt_lifecycle SET status=#{status},ai_use=#{aiUse},revision=revision+1,updated_at=#{now} WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND excerpt_id=#{id} AND revision=#{expected} AND revision<9007199254740991
